subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Chicken hearted
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. “**Easily scared**.”

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let’s look at the** meaning** of the given idiom/ phrase:
 
• The phrase ‘**Chicken hearted**’ means 'easily frightened ; cowardly.'
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• *The enemies proved themselves **chicken hearted **before the Indian army and ran away from the battlefield.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 1 ‘Easily scared’, which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ *Easily scared*
